tools.semgrep: ran (p/smart-contracts, 50 rules, 25 raw results on changed files)

findings.description: pool() ignores the return values of both swapExactTokensForTokens calls (prime->pair line 221, pair->target line 234) and the amountA/amountB returns of addLiquidity (line 247). Mitigated in practice because the function re-reads balanceOf after each step and the swaps carry minPairOut/minTargetOut slippage floors plus a minLP post-check; flagging because the returned amounts are the canonical swap output and the balance-delta approach assumes no other token movement.

All three router calls (two swaps + addLiquidity) pass deadline = block.timestamp, which is always satisfied at execution time and therefore provides no deadline/MEV protection for a held/delayed transaction. Slither's cited 'dangerous comparison' (liquidity >= minLP, line 250) is a misfire, but the underlying block.timestamp-as-deadline pattern is real. Slippage is bounded only by minPairOut/minTargetOut/minLP, which the keeper supplies. Kept per time-driven-suite policy. Aderyn corroborates (lines 221, 234).

pool() makes an external call (IUniboostPooler.pool) inside a for-loop over caller-supplied targets, and emits BatchPooled after the loop. MultiPooler holds no funds (pure forwarder) and each target Uniboost.pool is nonReentrant + onlyAuthorizedPooler, so the loop/reentrancy surface is low; note that targets are fully caller-controlled addresses (only the onlyPooler gate and target-side auth constrain them).

pool() modifier order is onlyAuthorizedPooler, whenNotPaused, nonReentrant (nonReentrant runs last). The reentrancy lock is acquired after the auth and pause view-checks; benign here because neither preceding modifier makes an external call, but flagged as a convention/hardening note.

crossFileNotes.description: Aderyn HIGH flags the constructor's IERC20Metadata(primeToken_).decimals() read followed by state writes (scale/ratio) as 'state change after external call'. This is a constructor-only view call with no reentrancy surface (no funds, contract not yet deployed). False positive; not elevated. Same detector also fires on pre-existing BalancerPoolerV2:102 and NudgeRatchet:44 (out of this regression's changed-file scope).

Slither/Aderyn note Uniboost does not formally inherit IUniboostPooler though its pool(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) matches the interface MultiPooler calls. ABI-compatible, so the forwarding call works; purely a conformance/style note. Discarded.
Aderyn HIGH on NFTMinterV2 (unchanged this run). Pre-existing, not introduced by story-042; noted for completeness, not a regression finding.

None security-relevant.
